title: Klein envelope
description: The one wrapper every `klein <verb> --json`, every `kleinlib.api` function and the MCP server's results share. Closed: the six keys below are the whole wrapper. Verb-specific content lives in `data`; `schemas/index.json` (or `klein schema`) says which data schema a verb uses. Within `format: 1` keys are only ever added.

klein.description: The engine version that produced this envelope.

format.description: The envelope format; raised only by a breaking change.

verb.description: The verb path, e.g. `verify` or `claims verify`.

data.description: Verb-specific result; empty when the verb was refused.

problems.description: Why not, or what to look at; empty when clean.

level.description: `error` makes the verb fail; `warn` is advice.

code.description: What kind of problem: `refused` (the engine declined, with the reason), `check` (a named check) or `notice` (something the engine printed). Open: new codes may be added.

name.description: The check's name, on `code: check` problems.
